limits: The measured speedup is a fixed tactical stat-evaluation workload, not overall optimizer wall time. Chosen total search budgets are unchanged.
Objective-equivalent scope zoom/eye-relief controls are ignored by native objectives; game appearance/magnification can differ. Lock a concrete sight to preserve its identity.
OLIGHT and other distinct effects remain separate; price and compatibility select concrete representatives.
Patch quantities are by effect type, not just total quantity. Counts are placement-independent only under the verified integer-stat-add condition.
Dependency-sensitive identities, scored calibration and bundled replacement contexts remain distinct.
Heuristic top-K search retains no global optimum/top-K guarantee; source-model checks do not establish actual game-client fidelity.
